title: MEOW: Medical Open-World Interactive Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.13935v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In open-world recognition, machine learning models not only make predictions on unknown structures ("generalized open-set"), but also continually learn and improve from those predictions over time. Interactive segmentation, despite its access to user feedback, has so far remained confined to the open-set setting. In this work we introduce MEOW, the first framework that turns non-interactive segmentation backbones into interactive open-world learners without updating learnable model parameters. MEOW combines parameter-free transductive reasoning with memory consolidation to accumulate knowledge and thereby improve future performance. Focusing on medical data, we show that MEOW consistently improves its own predictions on classes never seen during training, and transfers zero-shot to unfamiliar domains, including micro-CT data and other imaging modalities.

translated_title: MEOW：医学开放世界交互式分割
translated_abstract: 在开放世界识别中，机器学习模型不仅需要对未知结构进行预测（“广义开放集”），还要随着时间推移从这些预测中持续学习并不断改进。交互式分割尽管能够获取用户反馈，但迄今为止仍局限于开放集设定。在这项工作中，我们提出了MEOW，这是首个能够在不更新可学习模型参数的情况下，将非交互式分割骨干网络转变为交互式开放世界学习器的框架。MEOW将无参数的传导推理与记忆巩固相结合，以积累知识并从而提升未来性能。聚焦于医学数据，我们展示了MEOW在训练中从未见过的类别上能够持续改进自身的预测，并可零样本迁移到陌生领域，包括micro-CT数据和其他成像模态。
tldr: MEOW是首个无需更新模型参数即可将非交互式分割骨干网络转变为交互式开放世界学习器的框架，通过结合无参数传导推理与记忆巩固，实现对未见类别的持续性能改进以及零样本跨模态迁移。
en_tdlr: MEOW is the first framework that turns non-interactive segmentation backbones into interactive open-world learners without updating model parameters, combining parameter-free transductive reasoning with memory consolidation to achieve continuous improvement on unseen classes and zero-shot transfer across medical imaging modalities.
